subject.title: fix: strip volatile output from exec result hash to fix no-progress detection (#93917)

question: Should stable failed exec retries ignore volatile output and trip critical/global blocking after the configured threshold?
rationale: The patch is narrow, but it intentionally changes when repeated failed exec attempts stop an agent, so maintainer intent is needed for the availability tradeoff.

options.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
options.body: Merge after docs and validation if maintainers want stable failed exec outcomes to stop runaway sessions earlier.

options.title: Defer for broader loop policy
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want session-wide or fuzzy loop-detection semantics settled before this narrower exec hash change.

recommendation.title: Accept stricter failed-exec blocking
recommendation.body: Merge after docs and validation if maintainers want stable failed exec outcomes to stop runaway sessions earlier.
